input.summary: Renewal only by mutual written agreement; delete Licensor's unilateral 7-year renewal option.
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the Licensor's unilateral option to extend for a further seven years so that any renewal (including its pricing) requires mutual written agreement, consistent with the balance of Article IV. Our playbook treats one-sided multi-year renewals as unacceptable.

ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: The Agreement may be renewed only by mutual written agreement of the parties.
